Although the start and end times of the rainy season in various parts of our country are somewhat different, they have their internal pattern; especially in the eastern region, the length of the rainy period in various places is mainly caused by the north-south displacement of a large-scale rain belt. The figure below is a histogram of the average daily precipitation (mm) in some regions from May 1 to August 31, 2003. (Note: the annual precipitation in the Huai River Basin is about 600—800mm)

According to this, what is the most likely reason for the relatively little precipitation in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River at the end of July?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: it is a three-region daily rainfall bar chart from May 1 to Aug 31, and the middle panel for 长江中下游地区 shows little rainfall at the end of July after an earlier early-July rain peak. Then use the text clue that rain-period differences are caused by north-south movement of a broad rain belt. Since late July rainfall has shifted away from the Yangtze middle-lower reaches, infer that the area is under subtropical high/anticyclonic control rather than the rain belt. Therefore the most likely cause is 反气旋过境.

claims.source: At the end of July, precipitation in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River is low, most likely after the rain belt moved north or left

claims.claim: After the rain belt moves north or leaves, the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River are controlled by anticyclonic systems such as the subtropical high.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: This place is controlled by anticyclonic systems such as the subtropical high

claims.claim: Control by an anticyclonic system will strengthen descending air currents.
claims.label: knowledge
claims.source: Under the control of an anticyclonic system, descending air currents strengthen

claims.claim: Strengthening of descending air currents is not conducive to cloud formation and precipitation.
claims.label: knowledge
claims.source: Descending air currents strengthen, which is not conducive to cloud formation and precipitation

claims.claim: The reason for the relatively low precipitation in the middle and lower reaches of the Yangtze River at the end of July is most likely the passage of an anticyclone.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Therefore, the reason is most likely the passage of an anticyclone
